arguments.command:
python -c "
import more_itertools as mi

# Test split_at with maxsplit
result = list(mi.split_at('a.b.c.d', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1))
print(f'split_at with maxsplit=1: {result}')
assert result == [['a'], ['b', 'c', 'd']], f'Got {result}'

# Without maxsplit (original behavior)
result = list(mi.split_at('a.b.c', lambda c: c == '.'))
print(f'split_at without maxsplit: {result}')
assert result == [['a'], ['b'], ['c']]

# With keep_separator and maxsplit
result = list(mi.split_at('a.b.c.d', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1, keep_separator=True))
print(f'split_at with maxsplit=1, keep_sep=True: {result}')
assert result == [['a', '.'], ['b', 'c', 'd']], f'Got {result}'

# With keep_separator, no maxsplit
result = list(mi.split_at('a.b.c', lambda c: c == '.', keep_separator=True))
print(f'split_at with keep_sep=True, no maxsplit: {result}')
assert result == [['a', '.'], ['b', '.'], ['c']]

# Edge case: ends with separator
result = list(mi.split_at('a.b.', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1))
print(f'split_at ends with sep, maxsplit=1: {result}')
assert result == [['a'], ['b']], f'Got {result}'

# Edge case: starts with separator  
result = list(mi.split_at('.a.b', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1))
print(f'split_at starts with sep, maxsplit=1: {result}')
assert result == [[], ['a', 'b']], f'Got {result}'

# All separators with maxsplit=2 -> 3 chunks, all empty since all are separators
result = list(mi.split_at('...', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=2))
print(f'split_at ... with maxsplit=2: {result}')
assert result == [[], [], []], f'Got {result}'

# maxsplit=1 on '...' -> 2 chunks, both empty
result = list(mi.split_at('...', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1))
print(f'split_at ... with maxsplit=1: {result}')
assert result == [[], []], f'Got {result}'

# Mixed: 'a...b' with maxsplit=2
result = list(mi.split_at('a...b', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=2))
print(f'split_at a...b with maxsplit=2: {result}')
assert result == [['a'], [], ['b']], f'Got {result}'

print('split_at tests passed!')
"
